rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 1 of 3 on a 40 m rope through the technical section.
hazards: The compact granite has few holds and is harder to reverse than to climb; one party found a heather-camouflaged hole in the rock.

rappel_detail.station: The next anchor down the technical section.
